scope: Read-only device and signing inspection; no application build, installation or launch during preparation
privacy: No device identifier, serial number, device name, network address or provisioning device list is recorded

deviceQueries: devicectl device info apps --bundle-id (target application only) --include-all-apps
signingQueries: Existing local provisioning profiles; only capability and matching booleans retained

limits: No physical iPhone performance result is claimed by this readiness report.
Device lock and connection state may change after inspection.
The candidate inputs are live canonical symlinks; record input hashes immediately before the actual test.

followUp.attempt: A subsequent Dart MCP profile launch timed out before a VM connection or benchmark result. An iOS Runner.app build artifact exists locally; installation and launch were not verified.
followUp.connection: A later target-app query also timed out on the development network connection.
followUp.note: candidatePreparation describes the earlier preparation snapshot, not the subsequent launch attempt.
